As alien gadgets disrupt the shopping district, your relationships with the women around you begin to change... A life of temptation and unexpected encounters awaits. Are you ready for what comes next?

Adventure into dusty desert canyons, discover crumbling hidden passageways, and untangle Silvercrest’s secrets before you meet an untimely end.

apps.name: Animal Sokoban Endless
apps.short_description: Four animals, four ways to move boxes: a cat, an elephant, a boar and a kangaroo. Learn their rules in handcrafted stages, then play fresh Endless puzzles every time, including hard ones that stump seasoned puzzlers. Go for the Master achievements.

Play locally with friends, test your skills in Online VS, and explore the world of Internet Space in a single-player or co-op Story Mode - plus a challenging Roguelite gauntlet!

apps.name: Archivist

Behind the back door, something hungry is waiting, and the only thing it eats is files. No one has ever retired from this archive.

apps.name: ARCHWIZARD

Knowledge based progression. Full of secrets.

apps.name: Backdraft
apps.short_description: The deckbuilding brawler. Backdraft is a hero vs hero roguelike battle for board control. Draft your deck, summon your minions, and unleash game-flipping combos. Conquer the six realms solo, or challenge your friends online.

apps.name: Backrooms 95
apps.short_description: Explore eerie liminal spaces in a low-poly Backrooms horror experience inspired by the aesthetics of forgotten 90s technology.

apps.name: Bad Ideas Game Jam Collection 2026
apps.short_description: The Bad Ideas Game Jam Collection 2026 is a showcase of 50 short-form videos and single-player games that encompass a variety of genres from visual novels, platformers, rpgs shooters, rhythm, and puzzle games. Each following a theme of trying to make games that think Outside the Box!

apps.name: BANX
apps.short_description: Play as BANX, a hero wielding a balloon as his weapon... and head? In this hand-animated action adventure set in a solar-punk world, take on hundreds of enemies in fast-paced, free-flow combat, fight an epic cast of bosses, and freely bounce through a stunning, dense, and vertical city.

apps.name: Bash Moto
apps.short_description: Tear up the West Coast in a 90s-themed beat'em up motorcycle racing game. Kick, punch, and bash rival bikers to claim the cash prize while dodging traffic, obstacles and hot-pursuit cops. Wreck your ride or run out of cash for bail, and it is game over.

apps.name: BATTROPICA
apps.short_description: Treasure! Battles! Rewards! Set sail with cheerful pirate Mia for a tropical action adventure. Hunt for treasure across islands and beneath the waves, fight giant monsters with your crew, then unwind with beach games, hot springs and a little flirty fun.

apps.name: BEAST NEGOTIATOR
apps.short_description: Fighting isn't the only way. Explore dungeons, negotiate with the monsters you meet, and recruit them. Command your party in side-view turn-based battles - a 2D dungeon RPG built around befriending monsters.

apps.name: Beauty Territory

apps.name: Before the Tee

Shape fairways and greens, hire a crew, keep the tee sheet moving, and handle whatever the day throws at you. Win the right to host tournaments and climb the rankings of local critics.

apps.name: Beware of Ants

Outside there's a toad.

Find and customize a large number of skills. Rebuild your brain from scratch and rise against a tyrannical God in this turn-based roguelike RPG!

apps.name: Blight Brigade

apps.name: Blood Covenant
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror job-sim. Your crew of hazmat cleaners works the night shift for a dispatcher who knows more than he lets on, scrubbing blood out of places nobody else will go. Something has moved in at every site, and you'll have to work out what it is before you pay the altar.

apps.name: Bloody Lens
apps.short_description: Break into a twisted asylum as Ray, a content creator hunting for viral truth. Start with nothing but your camera, but scavenge your way up to axes, shotguns, and an AK-47 to blast the grotesque experiments hunting you. Manage your rare ammo, solve puzzles, and survive the broadcast.

apps.name: Blue Hawaii Aniki's Small Celebration vol.4

"Blue Hawaii Aniki's Small Celebration" is a radio show that Blue Hawaii Aniki appears on to make a little extra cash.
If you enjoy that unique radio atmosphere, I highly recommend giving it a listen.
It runs for about two hours. Feel free to start from Vol. 4.

apps.name: Boop The Snoot

apps.name: Brave the Descent

apps.name: Brikk

apps.name: Broken Oath

Production, world wide shipping, marketing and so much more!

apps.name: Bumper Bout

apps.name: BUTCHER SARU
apps.short_description: Seeking revenge for his sibling, Saru steals the necklace that holds the secret to the antidote and becomes the target of a terrorist organization. apps.name: Camping With Friends

apps.name: Case Shop Simulator

Can you pay off your debt, save up, and buy a home?

apps.name: Cast & Found

apps.name: Catnip Wars 2: Empires
apps.short_description: Build a trading empire across a never-ending galaxy of cats. Haggle with Otter ports, outrun Raccoon raiders and fly your own fighter into the wreck-choked Tangles while 13 NPC factions roam in real time. Play solo, with friends, or host your own persistent universe.

apps.name: CatPurrEngineRace
apps.short_description: Pet cats to power your engine with purrs! Pet with one hand and steer with the other as you race around the world and collect cats and cars. Take on World Tour, CAT—a high-difficulty, roguelike-inspired 30-race challenge—or compete online and in Time Attack!

apps.name: Centuries
apps.short_description: Grow a small camp into a thriving medieval settlement. Shape its expansion, develop its economy and care for the households that call it home. Balance your ambitions with the everyday needs of a growing community.

apps.name: CHAOS: Dread Manifest
apps.short_description: CHAOS: Dread Manifest: A psychological-horror RPG set in a decaying and violent world.

apps.name: CHESS.0
apps.short_description: CHESS.0 is a modern take on classic chess, featuring a neon-styled interface, smooth controls, a responsive chess engine, and immersive synthwave sound design that enhances every move for a visually and audibly engaging experience.

apps.name: ChildStory 2: Say Cheese!
apps.short_description: Say Cheese is a farmer simulator with roguelike elements, in which Sonya will not only develop her own cheese factory, but also find out the reason why everyone in the city has nightmares at night.

apps.name: Chimera Haven: Survivors

apps.short_description: A cozy incremental game about chopping wood! Sit back, Relax and Recruit forest friends who share your love of wood and together, conquer the grove, one tree at a time!

apps.name: Chopstick Together
apps.short_description: A chopstick simulation game where you work a pair of chopsticks to carry beans.

apps.name: Chronicles Of The Sinner
apps.short_description: Chronicles of The Sinner is a first-person survival horror set inside an abandoned orphanage. As a lone investigator, you are sent to uncover what happened within its walls. Explore, gather resources, solve puzzles, and try to survive… if you don’t lose yourself first.

apps.name: Colonials
apps.short_description: Pixelart Auto Battler about turning one expendable trooper into an army of Space Colony. You give the orders. They fight the bugs.

apps.name: Compost Comrades

apps.name: Contenir

The gameplay will flow to the sound of her voice while she shares her view of her body, romance, emotions, and much more... Filled with handcrafted visuals and a touching story, this game will strike your heart.

apps.name: Cop Bastard
apps.short_description: COP BASTARD is a classic FPS set in early ’90s Japan. Play as a tough detective and blast through waves of yakuza in relentless action inspired by ’90s films. No puzzles, perks or upgrades - just corridors, enemies and the chance to spit in their faces.

apps.name: Corner Quest
apps.short_description: An idle auto-battler that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

apps.name: Cousin's Playtime
apps.short_description: In this cozy simulation game, you get to spend time with your cousin Honoka. Entertain her while your parents are having a chit-chat, give her some pats, talk about favorite things, but don't touch her plushie! You have a limited time to make Honoka happy, so make it count.

apps.name: Cozy Campfire Club
apps.short_description: Grab your friends and set up a cozy campfire. Chat and make friends as you relax by the campfire, customize your campsite, forage in the forest, fish in the river, catch bugs, and cook up different foods in this cute hangout game.

apps.name: Crazy Chess
apps.short_description: A game based on chess. Solve 50 puzzles on boards of every kind and shape, with different types of tiles. Mechanics and rules that are a little crazy but a lot of fun.

apps.name: Creepy Horrors: My Little Blood Cult 2
apps.short_description: Build your roster of Creepy Horrors in this spooky occult creature-collector RPG. Crawl through crypts collecting cursed curios and ingredients, combining them to summon adorable Horrors, wielding them in strategic 3v3 battles against rival sects. The Crypts are calling. Will you answer?

apps.name: Crimson Haze
apps.short_description: A squad-focused Vietnam War RTS. Command an air-mobile company through jungle, rice paddies and contested villages. Deploy troops by helicopter, call in artillery and air support, and fight for the trust of civilians. Every soldier has a name. Every loss is remembered.

apps.name: Crinimal Land
apps.short_description:
Crinimal Land is an open-world game featuring animals, inspired by the police missions in some of the most beloved games from the 2000's, but more family-friendly.

Be a police officer that can run, crouch, aim and use non-lethal weapons to shoot groups of crinimal animals.

apps.name: Critters Vs. Predators
apps.short_description: The food chain is fighting back. Collect a squad of tiny garden critters, gear them up and send them against the foxes, snakes, hawks and cats that hunt them. A cozy, chaotic auto-battler RPG: fight on auto or call every move. No pay-to-win.

apps.name: Cry Me a Cosmos
apps.short_description: Build a deck of Mortals with Temperaments and plant them in your garden. Engineer chain reactions to harvest their Tears. Survive twelve escalating tributes and gather 666 Tears to bring about the Apocalypse.

apps.name: Cycle of the First Dawn
apps.short_description: A slow, story-rich xianxia idle RPG about cultivation, discovery, and reincarnation. Work, train, explore, and uncover new systems across repeated lives. Progress carries forward, the world changes, and each journey reveals more than the last.

apps.name: Dark Awakening
apps.short_description: Researcher Evelyn investigates a mysterious entity behind a series of supernatural occurrences. Uncover eerie anomalies, solve cryptic puzzles, and unravel the dark secrets hidden within a seemingly ordinary house, where reality is not always what it seems.

apps.name: Dark Looter
apps.short_description: Dark Looter is a browser-based hacking simulation game. Build your rig, steal files from virtual institutions, mine cryptocurrency, and climb the hacker ranks — all in a persistent online world.

apps.name: Defend Your Land
apps.short_description: A pixel art idle auto-battler: your warrior or mage fights waves of bugs on their own while you power them up with weapons, gems, relics and skills. Progress keeps going even when the game is closed. 4 difficulties, 40 worlds and superbosses.

apps.name: Demon Touch!
apps.short_description: In this playful simulation, team up with Sitri, a cheeky little demon in trouble. Train together, boost your stats, bond through chatting, and hunt demons to help her regain her power. Progress through the story, defeat your enemies, and reach a happy ending together!

apps.name: DEMONIC MAIDENS CARDS
apps.short_description: Hentai strategy game where you face girls in turn-based card duels. Win matches, upgrade your deck, and unlock adult endings with each rival. +18 content.

apps.name: Desecrated
apps.short_description: Desecrated is a fast paced FPS inspired by retro fps. Grab your guns, regain your powers and slaughter those who stand in your way.

apps.name: Devout Saintess Selenia
apps.short_description: A dramatic, erotic RPG of a Busty MILF who is a Saintess! The classic fantasy RPG of a married, cheste Saintess getting defiled by dirty men! The lustful and immoral adventure is about to begin...

apps.name: Dice Must Work
apps.short_description: One button. Infinite luck. You’re the newest Luck Operator at Fortunex Corp. Roll dice slot machines, buy and combine dice, upgrade everything, gamble every ticket and pick roguelite badges for bizarre clients. No tutorial needed: just roll.

apps.name: Digitroids
apps.short_description: A short incremental game about harvesting Biomass from strange creatures to raise the Digitroid army. Upgrade the Finger to go full-clicker or focus on Digitroid customization for an idle path. Praise the Finger!

apps.name: Dino Cleanup
apps.short_description: Clean every corner of the world to save cute dinosaurs from the flood of goop in this nostalgic 3D platformer.

apps.name: DodgeBaller
apps.short_description: Dodgeball is a martial art. Challenge your friends up to 4 players locally or online! Play as unique characters with varied styles and prove you are the ultimate Dodgeballer Artist.

apps.name: Dokkaebi Night Market
apps.short_description: Draft ingredients, reroll your choices and trim your deck to build a thriving night market. Watch food synergies unfold on an automatically dealt counter, discover rare dishes that stay and grow in your deck, and meet rising sales targets across seven nights.

apps.name: Domino Together
apps.short_description: A game about standing up every last domino.

apps.name: Doomfield:The Maze
apps.short_description: Doomfield: The Maze is a single-player horror minigame where you explore a cornfield maze to find your missing dog while evading two deadly virus entities. Venture off the main path to discover hidden areas where the digital memory grows increasingly distorted.

apps.name: Dragon's Chronicles~双星のレギンレイヴ~
apps.short_description: A super-authentic hardcore strategy simulation fantasy that blends respect for tradition with a challenge to the unknown, nostalgic yet new.

apps.name: Dual Cores
apps.short_description: A post-apocalyptic team-based sword-and-sorcery action RPG with tons of overlapping choices you can use to design your ideal battlemage.

apps.name: Duelyst: Legends
apps.short_description: Duelyst: Legends is a modernized version of the classic tactical CCG from Counterplay Games, reimagined as an offline single-player experience.

apps.name: Dust & Dig
apps.short_description: Dig anywhere for buried treasure, wrestle rattlesnakes with fully physics-driven hands, and haul the loot back to town to sell. Buy bigger shovels, follow legendary treasure maps and take on three desert bosses: alone, or in online co-op with up to 3 friends.

apps.name: El Velo de la Muerte
apps.short_description:
A psychological horror game inspired by the myths and legends of Mexican folklore, set in the Juárez Hospital in Mexico City in 2007.
Explore, solve puzzles, fight entities from beyond and reconstruct the truth behind a forgotten tragedy.

apps.name: Elderfeast
apps.short_description: Hunt. Carve. Cook. Elderfeast is a co-op action game where the monsters are the menu. Hunt Lovecraftian horrors across the galaxy and slice them apart for ingredients to make your next meal. The better you cook, the stronger you become, but there's always something more terrifying to hunt next.

apps.name: Elf in Training
apps.short_description: Elf in Training is a chaotic couch co-op game where Santa’s newest recruits sneak into homes to deliver presents, eat cookies, and stuff stockings. Dodge angry parents and Christmas folklore creatures as you race to finish each delivery and earn your place as one of Santa’s elves!

apps.name: Encave
apps.short_description: Build customizable killrooms, scavenge, craft, upgrade and fight off waves of bioengineered monsters, that smash through walls, break your defenses, and carve new paths toward you in this hybrid FPS, tower defense and base builder set in a fully destructible underground biotech facility!

apps.name: Epic Boss Fighter
apps.short_description: Huge epic beasts have come to conquer the world, and only one guy can stop them. He is not happy about it. Fight ten giant bosses, grab every coin they drop, buy upgrades and go again. Each run you get a bit stronger. Each boss gets a bit meaner.

apps.name: Eternal Solitude
apps.short_description: ETERNAL SOLITUDE is a new turn-based 4X fantasy game, set in the World of Eternal Solitude combining deep racial society development, empire and city building, tactical  combat, spells, espionage with far-reaching consequences of every decision. Become the true magic overlord, or die as a slave!

apps.name: Every Wednesday
apps.short_description: A laundromat. Every Wednesday. And stories that stay. Join Hideki in a small laundromat in the heart of a restless metropolis, where smartphones are not allowed and strangers slowly become part of each other’s lives.

apps.name: Everything Must Go!
apps.short_description: Four broke thieves. One supermarket. One thousand items. Race your friends to steal, sell, and upgrade — then throw groceries at each other until only one thief walks away rich. 4-player online party chaos. Keyboard & mouse.

apps.name: Evidentia
apps.short_description: Evidentia is a cooperative detective card game for friends. Each deck is a unique case. Analyze evidence, take risks, question everything — and find out if you can solve it before the final reveal.

apps.name: Fair21: Blackjack
apps.short_description: A pixel-art blackjack game built around verifiable fairness. Play classic 21 solo, at a three-seat multiplayer table, or in seven-hand elimination. Choose a player seed, then replay and audit every deal and settlement.

apps.name: Fairy Forge
apps.short_description: Explore a spooky fantasy world, craft unique weapons, fight monsters, befriend magical fairies, fly an airship to visit sky islands, and build bases in this action sandbox adventure.

apps.name: Fantasy Dasher's
apps.short_description: A frantic turn-based strategy game where every move is infinite until you collide with something. Outsmart your enemies, trigger traps, set up ambushes and plan your every move. A single mistake is all your enemies need.

apps.name: Farm & Feast
apps.short_description: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

apps.name: FEARSFROMARS
apps.short_description: You are a space hunter from Mars. Hunt with friends, capture bizarre aliens alive, and sell them to the highest bidder. In this galaxy, alien or not, they all share one fear... FEARSFROMARS.

apps.name: Felt That: Boxing
apps.short_description: Felt That: Boxing is a comedic boxing game set in a world where the charm of furry puppets collides with the fury of boxing. Step into the shoes of Ezra "Fuzz-E" Wright, an unlikely hero with a big heart. His quest? Battle his way through the Tournament of a Million Punches to save an orphanage!

apps.name: Flick
apps.short_description: Flick light switches on and off throughout a long-abandoned house to shift the environment from a safe reality to a blood-soaked echo where grisly puzzles manifest A psychological horror experience where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

apps.name: Floor 21
apps.short_description:
Christmas Eve, 1977. A journalist rides the elevator of the Belmont Grand, a grand hotel that has been closed for years.
The voice in the elevator calls the floors. The manager still walks the halls. Learn the rules of each floor, keep your
light, and find out what happened on Floor 21.

apps.name: Fors Magika
apps.short_description: Fors Magika is a strategic card game where your hand is your battlefield! Choose a wizard, cast elemental spells, use Blessings and Curses, and outsmart your opponents. Uncover the enemy wizard and defeat them in fast-paced battles where every card counts.

apps.name: FortressCraft : Phoenix
apps.short_description: The third iteration of the game that invented the Factory genre, FortressCraft :Phoenix takes the over-the-top base building and survival gameplay and cranks it up a hundred times. Build your mining base with hundreds of thousands of machines in it, explore alien landscape, heading deep underground.

apps.name: French Protest Simulator
apps.short_description: Protest for whatever you want: a real cause or the right to a nap. With your friends, you write the banner and slogans, then put your own photos on the placards. Day one: 4 protesters according to the organisers, 2 according to the police. By the end, thousands are chanting your words across Paris.

apps.name: Friends for Strawberry
apps.short_description: A filthy, horrific nightmare at sea, haunted by people and things cast away. Friends for Strawberry is a story-driven horror FPS where you are trapped on an island of garbage, held captive by the cannibal castaways dwelling there, and... something in the trash, that won't let anyone or anything go.

apps.name: Frontline 2042: Modern War Shooter
apps.short_description: Frontline 2042 is a fast-paced online FPS set on modern battlefields. Build your loadout, master a growing arsenal, and fight players worldwide in team-based and free-for-all PvP modes.

apps.name: Full Steam Undead
apps.short_description:
OPEN WORLD STEAM TRAIN + ZOMBIE VR ACTION!
Ride the rune train, explore Necropolis Island and slay the undead.
For Queen Victoria, it's time to roll: all aboard for undead destruction!

apps.name: Ga Infinity
apps.short_description:
Ga Infinity is a game about Ga, a little man who explores a laboratory.
Collect cheeses, survive sharp spikes and... Jump on a robot that can punch really well?

apps.name: Gacha Chaos Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: A cozy-chaotic co-op organizing sim. Sort 7,200 gacha capsules into 900 machines across 20 color zones, solo or with 1-4 players. Throw, catch, and SLAP capsules out of your friends' hands, unlock 13 team skills, and collect 100 capsule series. No timer, just chaos.

apps.name: Gachikoi Chronicles: Sorting Dreams
apps.short_description: By day, Jaco sorts adult photos. By night, he vies for his favorite creator’s attention. A visual novel with timed sorting, everyday choices, and four endings. Earn your wages, choose how to spend them, and make time for the people beyond the screen.

apps.name: Gaia Crisis
apps.short_description: Every 1000 years, a vessel is chosen to resurrect War Maiden, bringing death upon this Earth. Blessed by divine powers, you play as Charlotte, the world's last hope.

apps.name: Gamble Inc.
apps.short_description:
Spin slots and multiply profits in this money making incremental game. Hack into your work computer and siphon cash straight from the slots, into your bank. Corporations have reduced jobs to betting all you've got and letting the house (your boss) win. 

Now Hiring!

apps.name: Genesis: Rise of Life
apps.short_description: Play as a primitive cell in living microscopic ecosystems. Feed, flee, fight, and adapt your organism to survive increasingly hostile biological environments.

apps.name: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex - First Assault Online
Gloom Break
apps.short_description: A relentless action-puzzle game about escaping a strange pit.

apps.name: Gnorlbeam
apps.short_description: An on-rail shooter where you control an alien saucer, which effectiveness depends on your score. Be good alien, destroy bad aliens. Gnorlbeam your way to world domination!

apps.name: God's Favourite Monster
apps.short_description: In this Action RPG, fight through a deadly labyrinth filled with a variety of enemies, puzzles, and traps. Take the form of defeated enemies and use their abilities as your own! Do you have what it takes to survive?

apps.name: Googlick
apps.short_description: Retro arcade shoot em' up puzzler where you blast bricks, steal their color energy, and eradicate the color matching seeds nodes before the robotic army can grow! An authentic recreation of the golden age of arcade gaming with a custom built CRT cabinet experience! Come blasts some bricks!

apps.name: Graalonline Worlds
apps.short_description: Get your games tested by players from around the globe, or test it from anywhere yourself using the new cross-platform application.

apps.name: Gravepeak
apps.short_description: Your signal saves survivors—and brings the horde to your gates. Restore a mountain outpost, prepare supplies, and defend the signal tower in third-person combat. Keep broadcasting until the people in the valley reach safety.

apps.name: Gravity Breakout: Alien Vein
apps.short_description: Gravity Breakout: Alien Vein is a top-down roguelite shooter. Pilot your mech deep into an alien vein — mine for fragments, build weapons and talents, and survive 20 waves and 5 boss fights to reach the core.

apps.name: Gravity Express
apps.short_description:
A cart. Cargo. Gravity. Two idiots. What could go wrong? 

One cart, two players, total chaos! Drive through dangerous tracks while your friend protects the cargo, fights off bandits, and desperately tries to keep everything from falling apart in this hilarious co-op physics game.

apps.name: Great Space Race of 3032
apps.short_description: Test your piloting skills in a 6-DOF space racer. Match up against others in the matchmaking mode, compete against AI, or race the clock solo. Clear as many rings as you can, and clear the finish line to lock in your time, top speed and accuracy. Get there first to win.

apps.name: Gubble II
apps.short_description: Gubble II is a wild action-platformer game. Like in Gubble, you clear dozens of levels of screws, nuts and bolts by hopping on tools and removing those pesky  fasteners. It's a pacman fest of colorful Escher-like 3D levels. Made by OG Atari Crystal Castles devs and arcade world record holders.

apps.name: Gummy Tummy
apps.short_description: A co-op mining game set in a world made of candy. Bite tunnels through gummy terrain, haul loot and a bellyful of sugar back to the hub, then craft sharper teeth, bigger stomachs and soda-bottle jetpacks to dig deeper. Push past your tier and your teeth corrode go see the dentist!

apps.name: Gutting Goblins! 2
apps.short_description: Adventurers return to their village to find it burned down by a tribe of nearby goblins. It is time to return to slaughtering goblins in this next installment of Gutting Goblins!, with far more features and fun to be had! The indie hack and slash game is back!

apps.name: H.I.V.E. UNIT
apps.short_description: Survive the toxic fog in this 1–6 player co-op FPS. Expand an RO2 generator network, hunt hive fissures, repel relentless hordes, and defend your lifeline from the Hive Queen ..before low RO2 turns your own mind against you.

apps.name: Halloween Pumpkin Simulator
apps.short_description: Become a pumpkin on Halloween night! Absolute zen, midnight melancholy, and zero fuss. The perfect evening plan!

apps.name: Hammer These Nails!
apps.short_description: Hammer 10,000 nails.

apps.name: Hanzen: A Chinese Word Journey
apps.short_description: Discover the joy of learning Chinese: connect characters into words across 30 ink-wash themes, planned to grow to 100. Every word includes pinyin, English meaning, and audio. The interface stays in Chinese for immersion - hover any button for an English tip. Zen Mode or 3-minute Challenge.

apps.name: Haramball
apps.short_description: Haramball is a multiplayer football tactics card strategy game where you pick the players, merge their attributes, set up the best formations and then watch your tactics unfold in real-time. Will you play beautiful football or become the football terrorist you were always meant to be ? You decide.

apps.name: Harrowgate Asylum
apps.short_description: HARROWGATE ASYLUM is a first-person survival horror where fighting back is not an option. Study patrol routes, slip between hiding spots, and hold your breath while something walks past you in the dark. If you are seen, running is all you have left.

apps.name: Hear No Evil
apps.short_description: Hear No Evil is an acrobatic rhythm platformer set in a world driven by the beat. Find your footing and hop in when the music takes you.

apps.name: HELIX ARK
apps.short_description: Adam has crash-landed on an alien world with Eve, a human restoration device. Rebuild civilization from a single human, develop cities, and combine technology with cultures unlocked through alien diplomacy to fuel explosive population growth in this sci-fi incremental simulation.

apps.name: Hell n' Slash
apps.short_description: A brutal dark fantasy hack'n'slash roguelike. Carve through 100 cursed chambers with a colossal sword, an arm-mounted crossbow and an iron grappling hook, seal pacts in wax and blood, and outlast the bored god who narrates every one of your deaths.

apps.name: Hentai Tales: Under The Neighbor Glasses Slut
apps.short_description: When I moved into Sakura-so Apartments, I never expected my quiet neighbor, the shy glasses-wearing artist Rin Chishima, to hold such a secret.

apps.name: Hentai World Ninja
apps.short_description: Enjoy a relaxing yet challenging game that tests memory and concentration. Simple mechanics and increasingly difficult levels keep you engaged, helping you unwind while sharpening your mind with every move.

apps.name: Hex Code
apps.short_description: You take over desk 07. The previous occupant left a routine running — and it has started learning from you. Switch between yesterday, today and tomorrow, type what you saw, and notice the moment the game stops obeying you.

apps.name: Hikari! Harem Hot Springs Vol. 1
apps.short_description: Take the role of an aspiring mangaka who watches in shock as his dream girl sketches mysteriously come to life at the hot springs inn where he works. Teach these beauties from another world how to survive in ours, manage the chaotic ryokan, and slowly build your own steamy harem!

apps.name: HIRUN
apps.short_description:
HIRUN is an absolute banger of cyberpunk action roguelite where you blast, dash, and drift through neon-drenched hordes.
Stack insane upgrades, unlock dope characters, and slash through deadly bosses. The OVERLORD awaits you.
Die, rewire, and dive right back into the grid. Can you survive the rave?

apps.name: Hit the Fly
apps.short_description: Let your instincts run wild! Take revenge on these pesky little bugs for everything! But remember they come in different colors and behave in different ways. To catch them off guard, don’t forget to use your "Super Hits". BANZAI!!! =))

apps.name: Hollow Oaks
apps.short_description: Someone or something is out there.  Watching from just beyond the trees.  Survive a night at Hollow Oaks in this 2 player co-op horror experience inspired by 1980s slasher movies.

apps.name: HoloVista
apps.short_description: Use your in-game camera in full 360° to photograph mysterious spaces, exploring lush environments in a dreamlike mansion. Search for objects, solve puzzles, confront your deepest secrets and confess them online as Carmen, junior architect and new hire at an elusive firm.

apps.name: hongchenyouji
apps.short_description: Hong Chen You Ji is a 2D top-down pixel wuxia action RPG. Play a village-raised youth seeking his origins among sects and officials. Real-time combat uses movement, weapons, and martial arts. Day, night, weather, and seasons change what you can do. Be a hero, doctor, or escort on your own path.

apps.name: Hot Wax
apps.short_description:
Place candles. Light a wick. Burn it all down.
Hot Wax is a fresh new take on classic falling block puzzlers, where creating chain reactions is key to performing successful incantations. The temple and its eldritch resident await you, eagerly.

apps.name: How To Goblin
apps.short_description: How To Goblin is a cozy desktop idle game where a tiny goblin crafts weapons on a dungeon platform while you do other things. Collect rare loot, sell items, purchase upgrades, and complete your collection!

apps.name: I'm not an Idiot
apps.short_description: Durak in 4D: the fourth dimension is time, because you can rewind. Bring your friends to the table, throw the cards into the middle, stick on stickers that rebuild the game, and argue about who the idiot is. Not me.

apps.name: Idle Swimmers
apps.short_description: A relaxing idle swimming game where you catch fish, unlock new locations and characters, customize your swimmer, and enhance your abilities with helpful pets and power-ups.

apps.name: Ignite the Depths
apps.short_description: Ignite the Depths is an atmospheric dark-fantasy PvE dungeon crawler set within a sprawling, hand-crafted labyrinth. Descend into the darkness alone or unite with up to 4 players in a co-op adventure. Will you conquer the Abyss?

apps.name: IIIIIIlI
apps.short_description:
"Draw. Disguise. Kick the can."
An asymmetric versus game of drawing and can-kicking, set on pixel-art stages.
"Mimicry" by doodling on yourself and the stage to blend in, plus fast-paced mind games that end in minutes.
Enjoy online matches for up to 16 players — casually, with AI bots or friends.

apps.name: In Shine We Rise
apps.short_description:
A dark fantasy co-op survivors-like where MOBA-style abilities replace auto-attacks.
Combine your heroes' skills to break the hordes of a fallen kingdom, upgrade your characters between runs, and carve your way up a cursed mountain.

apps.name: Infinitynoid
apps.short_description: Break an infinite field of bricks in every direction. Every ring is a new level, every level unlocks a new chiptune track, and the shop turns one lonely ball into a storm of exploding, block-shredding chaos. Then zoom out. Forever.

apps.name: Integration Test
apps.short_description: A terminal game about surveillance, identity, and editing your own source. In development for PC/Steam Deck.

apps.name: Iron Curtain Call
apps.short_description: WW3: Third time's the charm! A fast-paced cartoon-noir FPS set in an absurd alternate 1965. Dash, grapple and parry through a wind-up robot army, turn enemies into health and ammo, and bring down theatrical bosses with an arsenal of very undiplomatic weapons.

apps.name: It Was Supposed to Be a Vacation!
apps.short_description: 说好只来旅游，怎么连每一顿饭、每一段闲聊都想留下？这是一款以成都旅行为主题的单机互动影像游戏。跟随镜头走进街头巷尾，在剧情节点选择出行方式、品尝当地美食、回应陌生人的热情，让日常小事成为旅途中的意外惊喜。你的选择会留下不同的旅行印记，影响日终手记与睡前故事的解锁。通过分支图回看另一种可能，在旅行记录中收藏照片与经历；也可以使用自动保存和已看内容快速回看，按自己的节奏体验这段旅程。写下属于你的成都记忆。

apps.name: It's Not a Bomb
apps.short_description: Throw explosives, dodge chaos, and blow your friends sky-high in this frantic multiplayer party game! Battle across explosive arenas, unleash crazy power-ups, and prove who's the master of mayhem in modes like Battle Royale, Capture the Flag, Demolition, and Team Battles!

apps.name: Jarkeeper
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game in a spooky old mansion on a stormy night. You sleepwalked out the front door, and all 3,120 specimen jars hit the floor. Carry armfuls, learn odd little spells from the bimbous and put every jar back on its shelf.

apps.name: Javelin
apps.short_description: Strategic roguelike with party-combat.

apps.name: Jianghu Remembers
apps.short_description: Jianghu Remembers is a hardcore wuxia roguelike auto battler. Be born as someone in the jianghu and choose how to live. Gather companions and manuals through fortunate encounters and hidden realms, and combine arts into the strongest build.

apps.name: JiivJiiv
apps.short_description: Raise a flock of felt chickens on Grandma's old farm. Throw eggs into the truck, migrate across six regions with their own rules and follow her postcards to the legendary First Hen. A cozy idle game with no ads, no premium currency and a real ending.

apps.name: John Wick Hex
apps.short_description: John Wick Hex is a fast-paced, action-oriented strategy game that makes you think and strike like John Wick, the professional hitman of the critically acclaimed film franchise.

apps.name: KAREI - ENDLESS DEATH MATCH
apps.short_description: A grid-based, turn-based puzzle roguelike. Play a lone kunoichi ascending an endless castle — read each floor like a puzzle, arm yourself from its walls, and cut down the oni in your path. One wrong move ends your run.

apps.name: Kick Rocks
apps.short_description: A relaxing first-person incremental game: kick lumpy rocks up an endless road until they're perfect spheres. Every kick wears the stone like a real pebble. Spend the chips you knock off on new moves and boots, and roll on through ten worlds, from the desert to hell.

apps.name: KNURLWORM
apps.short_description: Knurlworm is a short character-driven game where every visual asset is made from real woodcut stamps pressed onto real paper. Watch a lone Carver's story unfold print by print as he searches for a mythical worm said to be able to change a person's fate. The KNURLWORM.

apps.name: La Spaghetti
apps.short_description: Jump and Run through tricky levels in La Spaghetti, a cute 2D pixel platformer! Guide your noodle past dangerous meatballs and stomp on bouncy slimes. Your goal is to grab the tasty tomato to open the portal and reach the next Level.

apps.name: Laguna Rosa: A long story with reckless consequences
apps.short_description: Welcome aboard, Captain, to Laguna Rosa—an idle game where you become the owner of a pirate island. Build and upgrade structures, win over beautiful girls, and use their talents to outsmart your enemies and turn the island into a center of power and luxury.

apps.name: Lambslide
apps.short_description: A cooperative, physics based, sheep herding game set on one very large alpine mountain. You shout at the sheep with your real voice, draw them in with a crook, and scare them off with a hand puppet of a dog. Get the flock down the mountain.

apps.name: Lapiness Sapphire -Galactic Exit 10-
apps.short_description: Trapped in an interdimensional wormhole, a rookie space cop must spot the anomalies to escape! Choose the right door and get one step closer to home—choose wrong, and what terrible fate might await...?!

apps.name: LARVIS
apps.short_description: Draw your cards, uncover stories, and question everything in this magical Indie experience that transcends the boundaries of art and tabletop games.

apps.name: Last Chickenburg
apps.short_description: Last Chickenburg is an offbeat action RPG blending survival, strategy, and puzzle elements. Survive the Humanfolk’s arena, rise as the Chicken King, and lead the Chickenkind to reclaim its homeland.

apps.name: Learn Abroad: Japanese
apps.short_description: Learn Japanese through a cozy study-abroad simulation. Attend guided classes, practice with interactive activities, and complete homework to earn money. Explore Shibuya, recharge at cafés and ramen shops, and build a daily routine around learning something new.

apps.name: Leon&Suharto
apps.short_description: In the Slums, people kill for a drop of noble blood. And Leon has it. Lies, revenge, a connection that bleeds, and a game that stares back at you. A dark episodic novel about those who survived — and are still paying the price.

apps.name: linelights-001
apps.short_description:
A nostalgic visual novel set on a quiet, remote island somewhere in Japan.

Follow the words of the islanders and the small things that feel slightly off in everyday life, and draw closer to the truth this place has kept hidden.

This is not a story about exposing the truth.

apps.name: Little Outside
apps.short_description: LittleOutside turns a window on your desktop into a real one. Your webcam tracks your head, and the city, old town and coast outside shift with true perspective as you move. 3 hand-built views, 24 ambient tracks, and Steam Workshop support.

apps.name: Longshot Downs
apps.short_description: Broadcast-style 100% offline single player horse racing wagering simulator across 9 tracks. Watch four live simulcast feeds at once, get your money down before post time, and chain WIN picks at up to five venues into a Track Parlay — a jackpot bet that exists nowhere in real racing.

apps.name: Loot & Scoot
apps.short_description: Hide-and-seek tag where each thief is roped to a partner. Grab raining coins and stuff them into the Safehouse before the police sends you all to jail. Caught? Use drones and traps to knock police off the map and break out. Play with up to 10 friends online with proximity voice chat!

apps.name: Lost Freight
apps.short_description: Inherit your uncle’s run-down freight yard in rural Australia ... and his debt. Purchase unclaimed freight lots, appraise and repair what you find, then sell it for a profit. Pay off the debt, restore the yard and turn it into a booming business.

apps.name: Ludo Mosaic
apps.short_description: Ludo with verifiable dice and 14 richly detailed 3D boards. Start with your own seed, recalculate rolls and compare their fingerprints with the game record. Rotate and zoom freely. Play online, invite friends and explore multiple modes.

apps.name: Mai Pillow Smash
apps.short_description: A mental puzzle game about insomnia and the fragments that fill your head. Mai can't sleep. Every night, restless thoughts flood her mind. Match them, calm them, and clear the noise before it takes over.

apps.name: MAke Drama : MAD
apps.short_description: The RPG you've been waiting for! Chaos & Chaos! Build your ultimate girl party!

apps.name: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush
apps.short_description: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush fuses match-3 puzzles with physics-based Pachinko action! Match tiles to drop bouncy balls through pegs into multiplier slots for massive combos. Unleash powerful boosters, buy permanent upgrades, and dominate global leaderboards!

apps.name: Memories of Memories Anthology
apps.short_description: A kinetic novel collection, set in a world where memories are a commodity.

apps.name: Midget Kricket Fantasy Chat assistant
apps.short_description: Please wait while this get updated due to change of hands.

apps.name: Military Base Tidy Up
apps.short_description: A relaxing first-person sim about tidying up a forgotten military underground base. Shelve ammo crates, weapons, drones and gear, unlock new sectors and level up your skills – solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. No timers, no pressure.

apps.name: Minya in the Sky
apps.short_description: You’ll control Minya as she takes on the graduation exam at Sky Magic Academy, aiming to pass the exam and graduate. If you defeat a host of enemies and take down the final boss, Minya will graduate successfully. This game focuses primarily on third-person combat and treasure hunting.

apps.name: Mojiworld
apps.short_description: Remember when worlds felt endless? Mojiworld is a 2D side-scrolling action-RPG with that early-2000s "one more map" magic. Pick a class, rise into one of 17 master classes, take on the 12 zodiac bosses and team up with up to 4 friends in online co-op. Your adventure starts now!

apps.name: Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator
apps.short_description: Travel through 2010–2025 and trade historical stocks and cryptocurrencies with the benefit of hindsight. Build a fortune, survive unexpected costs, and uncover the story behind it all.

apps.name: Mossu
apps.short_description: Mossu is a botanical cubesat terrarium floating through the real solar system, with you and your friends as it's caretakers! Hands on plant growth, cubesat construction and exploration in your shared, persistent craft. Go from Earth orbit to the Martian surface!

apps.name: Moto Rogue
apps.short_description: Race your way up to world champion and show your true grit!

apps.name: Motor Park Architect
apps.short_description: Build and manage the motorsport park of your dreams. Choose from a variety of racing categories, manage your staff, and create a world-class motorsport destination hosting a wide range of competitions. Take on the fastest drivers from different championships and beat their lap records.

apps.name: Mutagenic Invitational
apps.short_description: Weld a mutant athlete out of whatever DNA you can swipe from the neighbourhood, then throw it into the world's least ethical youth athletics program. Compete live with friends or play solo across a brutal multi-sport tournament with trillions of unhinged combinations.

apps.name: MUTARIUM: Mutant Aquarium Defense
apps.short_description: Feed them and they mutate. Overfeed them and they turn on you. Mix MEAT, GLOW and ORE to grow your fish into adorable little horrors, then let them fight the failed experiments breaking into your tank. You never control a unit — what you feed is the whole strategy.

apps.name: My Metal Fairy
apps.short_description: Twenty metres beneath Bagannur, something lies strapped to a stretcher. Your job is simple: keep it asleep until 1 AM. Decode the printouts, stop the leaks, and whatever you do, don't move when it looks at you.

apps.name: My Protogen Engineer 2
apps.short_description: You got your body back, time to live your best life! Hop on, go on adventures with Xena and help her restore her planet's ecosystem

apps.name: Necro-Matcher
apps.short_description: A match-3 rogue-lite! Traverse through multiple floors battling baddies and discovering secrets in every unique run.

apps.name: Neden
apps.short_description: Play in a virtual world by creating your own character in a tons of different game modes with your friends. Join the Neden community.

apps.name: Neon Fragments
apps.short_description: Neon Fragments is a first-person shooter set in a dystopian near future. In a world where humanity crumbled under its own weight, there is not much left but despair and loneliness. How far are you willing to go for your only glimmer of light in this cruel world.

apps.name: No Good Pirates
apps.short_description: Build a pirate empire one leaky boat at a time. Trade, fight and board your way across a living low-poly archipelago where factions go to war, ports boom and bust, and sea monsters want a snack. Sail alone or with up to 8 friends in online co-op.

apps.name: No Service
apps.short_description: Uncover, experience, and survive service. Tasked with exploring and reporting any wrongdoing, you are the last train inspector on shift. descend into madness as this surreal comedy sonders your psyche.

apps.name: NodalBastion
apps.short_description: Defend the last AI core in a minimalist incremental game as you manage resources, upgrade your network, and unleash powerful skills. Resist humanity’s onslaught!

apps.name: Nodes of Jucia
apps.short_description:
A challenging but fluid action rogue-lite in which you hack, slash and shoot waves of enemies.
Between stages, manage and maximise your resources, spending them to gain skills, equipment, stats, or even mutations, if you're willing to risk the downsides.

apps.name: Northanda Chronicles
apps.short_description: Master role-based deckbuilding in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Build your party around the RPG holy trinity, craft a shared deck with powerful synergies, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

apps.name: NoWay
apps.short_description: You wake up in a dark underground labyrinth. Zombies roam, hunters wait. Stay silent, run, fight, or survive by acting like one of them. You’re not even sure there’s a way out.

apps.name: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer
apps.short_description:
You are the magistrate, and Lucifer stands trial as the defendant.
Judge the fallen angel in this dark romance visual novel.
Decide whether he is worthy of salvation, or doomed to destruction.

apps.name: OCCAM '97
apps.short_description: Terminsburg, 1997. You are a dispatcher for the Office for the Correction and Control of Anomalous Matter. Take calls and send operatives wherever reality breaks down. Protect your sanity. Have a good shift.

apps.name: Ode of the Wandering Knight
apps.short_description: *Ode of the Wandering Knight* is a wuxia‑themed cozy farming & life‑sim game. Step away from chaotic martial‑world conflicts. Till your land, build your homestead, farm, fish and craft, meet wanderers from jianghu, and live your own reclusive knight‑errant life.

apps.name: Oh My Balance!
apps.short_description:
The scale settles. Perfectly still.

Stack things on the right pan until they weigh the same as what is already on the left.

That is the whole rule.

apps.name: OMEA
apps.short_description: Your words shape the adventure. Omea is a revolutionary AI-powered narrative game where your personal Game Master responds to everything you write. No menus, no limits. Just type and forge your own legend across fantasy, sci-fi, mystery, and beyond.

apps.name: Omenwheel
apps.short_description: A role-playing autobattler with a living roulette companion. Prepare cards, gear and tactics, then watch Extra Spins turn your build into combos. Lead two samurai brothers on a roguelite journey through mythic Japan, solo or in two-player online co-op.

apps.name: On Break
apps.short_description: Fresnel Labs needs a Box Stacking Technician. Press the button, drop the box, build a tower that won't topple. Chain colors, earn your pay and spend it on strange office decorations that rewrite the rules of the job. Your robot supervisor, B.A.S.I.L., thinks you'll do great. Probably.

apps.name: One Million Canvas
apps.short_description: Claim your unique address among one million exhibition stands. Receive a starter painting and two blank canvases, create your artist, and open your own corner in a shared online museum.

apps.name: One More Broadside
apps.short_description: Build a pirate warship and survive seas full of enemy fleets, monsters and rival captains. Steer through the chaos while your weapons fire automatically, choose powerful upgrades, and set sail for one more run.

apps.name: One More Meter
apps.short_description: Dig, sell, upgrade, repeat. A warm, colorful 2D mining and idle game where every new layer brings a new ore and a new danger. One more click, one more meter.

apps.name: ONTOS
apps.short_description: A sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara. Uncover cryptic experiments, face unsettling encounters, and piece together a mind-bending narrative. The deeper you go, the more the truth unravels as you confront the ultimate question: What is reality?

apps.name: Oops! All Slimes
apps.short_description: Oops! All Slimes is a survival roguelite where you fend off an endless horde of slimes.  Improve your stats, learn new spells, and discover countless secrets! Ok, maybe not countless, but they're good, I promise.

apps.name: Orbital Defense 2899
apps.short_description: Space Year 2899. As the new Operations Chief of Japan's Space Facility Defense Office, protect orbital colonies from debris, space lifeforms and drone fleets. Build and upgrade defenses on 10 orbits with different routes, and reshape your tactics with 130+ research projects.

apps.name: Orbital Intruder
apps.short_description: Explore procedurally generated dead spaceships, complete dangerous contracts, collect loot, control doors and extraction, while an alien monster hunts and grows stronger.

apps.name: Oroboro
apps.short_description: Explore an open world and fight foes for loot and resources in a 2D side-scroller action RPG. Then return and share with your friendly NPCs, manage relationships, gossip, progress skills, and rebuild the destroyed town.

apps.name: Overboost: Carball
apps.short_description: Car football with boost, jumps and dodges, in an arena that reshapes itself for two to six teams. Take on bots, share one keyboard with up to three friends in splitscreen, or play online with a session code. The whole world is ray-marched from signed distance fields.

apps.name: Pangea: Chronicles of the Lost Continent
apps.short_description: Frank Frantic starts out in a junk shop and ends up on a continent from 335 million years ago. In between: a woman who hits VERY hard, a millionaire with too many secrets and a stone god with a broken heart. A point & click adventure with sharp humor, barrel-aged for 20 years.

apps.name: PAWSHOT
apps.short_description: PAWSHOT - a deadly roulette for true predators. Count your shells, put your paws, fangs, and shotgun to use. Your life is on the line. Good luck.

apps.name: Pelican Empyrean
apps.short_description: Share the delicious magic of abundance by cooking meals for all who come to Pelican's kitchen, in this roguelike cooking card game about mastering magic to amplify your culinary powers. Food is love!

apps.name: Petal Runner
apps.short_description: Hop on your bike and join Cali and Kira as they ride across the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a solarpunk, pixel art-powered open-world RPG about life, loss, and what we carry with us.

apps.name: Petoparak
apps.short_description: Build your squad of player cards and take to the cage in five-a-side arcade football. Play matches, earn coins, open packs and give your club its own look. One purchase: every card, pack and cosmetic is earned by playing.

apps.name: PHOSPHOR
apps.short_description: An action-packed retro cyberpunk roguelike platformer dropping players into an infested industrial abyss. Blast through hordes and giant bosses, and loot from 450+ weapons and upgrades. Every descent generated fresh. Die, keep what you forge, unlock operatives, and drop deeper into the PHOSPHOR.

apps.name: Pickpocket
apps.short_description: Pickpocket is an incremental game about stealing. Learn from your victims, get better loot, and advance through an extensive skill tree. Build your own crime empire!

apps.name: Piecework: The Jigsaw Museum
apps.short_description: Piecework is a cozy first-person jigsaw and tidying game. There has been an incident at the museum, and thirty masterpieces are now lying on the floor in nearly 28,000 pieces. The museum would very much like them back on the walls.

apps.name: Pigeons Must Die
apps.short_description: Fight through waves of subway pigeons—some of them smoke. Dodge the swarm while your weapons auto-fire, then spend Feathers to build a ridiculous arsenal. You’ll need it for the boss pigeons. Trust me.

apps.name: Pink Light
apps.short_description: In this action RPG, play as a devoted Sister cursed by a demon and stripped of healing magic. Fight through a deadly dungeon with fast-paced sword combat, various gear choices, and relentless traps. Uncover dark secrets before Yarashina City falls.

apps.name: Pint Sized
apps.short_description: Serve drinks as Coco and Hazel to earn enough nuts to pay the month's rent on your tree. Between Red Eddies, Blue Worswicks, and Green Gallis, run around the bar to grab glasses, pour pints, and serve some patrons. Be quick though, nobody waits for drinks forever.

apps.name: Pionero Capital
apps.short_description: From one-person online store to e-commerce giant - pack, drive and deliver orders across the open world of Pionero Island. Grow with employees, vehicles, properties and new businesses until the company runs without you. Solo or co-op

apps.name: Pizza Kidd
apps.short_description: A high-impact 2D action beat ’em up set in a gritty sci-fi fantasy world. Battle grotesque monsters, uncover ancient secrets, and unleash martial arts fury in this pixel art brawler inspired by 90's anime, noir comics, and arcade classics like Street Fighter II, Streets of Rage, and Ninja Warriors.

apps.name: Pizzapocalypse 2
apps.short_description:
Use your pizza to bounce, swing and dash in this 3D platformer!
Explore different countries, and put a stop to the greedy corporation selling Pizza-in-a-can!

apps.name: Place it Gently – Cozy Organizing
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person decorating game about turning empty rooms into comfortable spaces. Arrange furniture and everyday objects, personalize surface colors, and unlock new rooms as you decorate. Take your time and enjoy a relaxing experience with automatic saving.

apps.name: Plague Inc: The Board Game: The Video Game
apps.short_description:
Yes, this really is a video game of a board game of a video game!
Spread across the world, mutate deadly symptoms and battle rival pathogens to wipe out humanity. A 1–4 player tabletop game of infection, evolution and extinction based on the smash hit with over 200 million players.

apps.name: Planet Munchers
apps.short_description: Grow a handful of woodlice into a swarm of 10,000. Devour voxel planets, spend Chunks on upgrades and return stronger with permanent DNA research. Choose strange worlds, unleash destructive abilities and race through Time Trial in this space incremental.

apps.name: Pogo Together
apps.short_description: Bounce, fall, rage, and climb together. Pogo Together is a 1-4 player physics-based precision platformer where ridiculously jacked animals attempt to conquer brutal obstacles on pogo sticks. Help each other, kick each other off, or take on the climb alone.

apps.name: Possessed By Fate
apps.short_description: A yuri romance. After a ghost takes her apartment, a ghost hunter becomes the hunted—with her body the prize.

apps.name: Primal Tactica
apps.short_description: Recruit a team of Primals, then equip and evolve them to survive deadly encounters! Loot powerful Relics and Augments and stack synergies to create wild gamebreaking teams. Primal Tactica is a roguelike autobattler where TFT meets Slay the Spire, with thousands of possible builds.

apps.name: Prison Empire
apps.short_description: Enter prison as a nobody. Fight, trade and bribe your way up, build a crew, take territory from four rival gangs and turn the cellblock into a criminal empire across three prisons, alone or in online co-op. Or serve your time, win your appeal, or break out.

apps.name: Pro League Golf Simulator
apps.short_description: The deepest golf sim ever made. Six modes: watch a universe, raise a player from 16, or draft a fantasy team, plus Stroke, Team, and Combo careers. Play every round in 3D or sim it. Deep stats either way. Course designer and a golfer you can build.

apps.name: Prohibition Mafia
apps.short_description: Build a bootlegging business in 1920s America. Design your premises, hire a crew and keep the booze moving from brewing tubs to buyers. Manage supplies, wages and bottlenecks in a base-building and crew-management sim where every crate has to be carried.

apps.name: Project BLACKNODE
apps.short_description: Drift through asteroid fields, build your ship, and risk one more encounter. BLACKNODE is a space roguelite with two modes: explore and extract with recovered parts, or survive a  Endless arena and chase the leaderboard scores.

apps.name: Project Jump Scare
apps.short_description: Carry one object at a time through a forest, restore a broken carnival, and run when the Old One rises. Click or throw items to fight back in this single-player survival horror.

apps.name: Prophet Margin
apps.short_description: How far can you push one trade route? Connect villages, trade resources, and find clever routes to bigger profits. A thinky strategy city-builder inspired by Euro board games. Grow your network, optimize every connection, and please the gods.

apps.name: Pure Skill
apps.short_description: An incremental FPS where you can't aim, so you buy cheats. Win matches against bots, spend the credits on aimbot, wallhack and worse, and climb from a 1v1 aim map to packed lobbies while the chat slowly figures out what's going on. There is no anticheat.

apps.name: Puzzle Programmer
apps.short_description: Solve logic puzzles by hand, then build routines to solve them for you. Nineteen puzzle types, a daily puzzle, par scores to beat, and a Workshop for inventing puzzle types of your own.

apps.name: QtMesh Games
apps.short_description: QtMesh Games is a growing collection of compact indie games spanning strategy, stealth, tower defense, action, and family-friendly adventures. Jump between distinct worlds, earn shared achievements, and discover games built with QtMeshEditor.

apps.name: Questscape
apps.short_description: "Questscape: Escape from Cell 13" is the ultimate Escape Room Simulator! Can you make the escape? Play solo or in online co-op mode. Crack codes, find clues, and break free from the prison. Prove you have what it takes to break out – ready for the ultimate Escape Room experience!

apps.name: Rage Trip
apps.short_description: A difficult pixel-art platformer where every mistake gets roasted. Dodge saws and spikes solo, race 2–4 friends, or try Shared Fate co-op, where one death resets the whole team. The traps are visible. Your excuses won’t help.

apps.name: Raid Leader Simulator
apps.short_description: Lead a fantasy raid guild in this management auto battler. Recruit raiders, build lineups, and plan a response to every boss mechanic, then watch your team fight it out automatically while you handle contracts, morale, and loot.

apps.name: Rainbow Unicorn Dash: Forever X Infinity
apps.short_description: Collect your unicorn shoes to dash through enemies and chain together massive combos! Gather hearts, unlock fun abilities, and climb the leaderboards. Play solo or in local co-op.

apps.name: Re:Sister ~Two Siblings, One Secret Life~
apps.short_description: In this cozy life sim, reconnect with your little sister Miu as you start living together again. Share meals, go shopping, take walks, and enjoy quiet moments at home. Build trust, grow closer, and create new memories in your shared everyday life.

apps.name: Red Sol
apps.short_description: Build and defend a colony on an alien world. Connect production lines, keep life support running and grow thriving districts. Explore 10 biomes, research advanced technology and command your defences as the search for resources brings new threats to your doorstep.

apps.name: Reel Adventure: The Autobattler Journey
apps.short_description: With every battle, the slot machine spins, randomizing your enemies and rewards. In this roguelike autobattler, adapt your strategies, collect rare and powerful items, and guide your team through a journey fraught with danger. Combine skill, luck, and strategy to determine your fate.

apps.name: RELOADED
apps.short_description: This is a stationary defense FPS where you must fend off creatures closing in from all directions. There is no movement mechanic; armed with only a single handgun, you must survive the enemy's onslaught. Stay calm and confront the threat, even when there is no escape.

apps.name: Retailer
apps.short_description: RETAILER is a simulation game where you work a growing store of your very own, without the hassle of helping hands. It's stressful, but at least you're self-employed.

apps.name: Rev. NOiR
apps.short_description: Drawn together by chance, Asch and Finé set out to stop the Lightfall, a calamity that brings death to all it touches. As their journey to save the world unfolds, they uncover a fate neither expected... Defy cruel fate in the all-new RPG, Rev. NOiR.

apps.name: Revenant Dusk
apps.short_description: A top-down zombie survival game for solo or online co-op with up to 8 players. Scavenge a vast procedural world by day: craft, farm, fortify, build vehicles and level skills as you use them. Every Horde Night is bigger than the last. How many sunrises can you see?

apps.name: Rhythm of Resistance
apps.short_description:
In a future ruled by silence, your playlist is your weapon. In this Rhythm Metroidvania you fight to the beat, explore a dark interconnected world, and use forgotten songs to ignite the resistance.

Every beat, a rebellion. Every song, a revolution.

apps.name: Rice & Ink Family Chronicle
apps.short_description: A family simulation set in China, 1500–1850, in the canal and rice country around Suzhou: land, exams, shops, courts, lineage feuds, combat. Your family may live through the late Ming, the Manchu conquest and the Opium War — or it may not. It does not have to be honest.

apps.name: RocoKingdom
apps.short_description:
Roco Kingdom is a new evolution of open-world creature collecting games, where players become Rocos and set out to meet Jinies in the continent of Carosia.

Discover 400+ unique Jinies in this living open world. Form bonds with them as you grow together.

apps.name: Ruinous
apps.short_description: Craft devastating decks, gather loot to define your build, and defeat randomized dungeons and ruthless boss fights in a journey of risk, strategy, and ruin in this fantasy roguelike deckbuilder.

apps.name: Rulebound
apps.short_description: Rulebound is a surreal horror incremental game where survival depends on split attention. Trapped in the Void, play a strange disc-merging game on an old CRT TV. Bounce and merge discs, buy upgrades, and forge 3 Golden Discs while watching for entities in the dark.

apps.name: Run Goldie, Run!
apps.short_description: Master fast-paced combat in a Goldilocks-inspired action roguelike where precise parries, swift dodges, and relentless attacks are the key to survival. Fight your way running through a Mystical Forest teeming with deadly foes, formidable bosses, and three enraged Bears.

apps.name: RunGun Riot
apps.short_description: Drop into a neon 2D battle royale. Choose your fighter, scavenge weapons and gear, and fight across rooftops, interiors and underground routes. Use class abilities, break through cover, and stay ahead of the storm to outlast the riot.

apps.name: Sacred Angel Crossnia Heart
apps.short_description: In this adventure game with RPG elements, play as a boy named Batsu, who awakens as the heroine Crossnia Heart. Transform, battle the evil organization Despercoia, absorb their power to upgrade your suit, and protect the city from crime!

apps.name: Salmon Samurai
apps.short_description: An arcade slicing game with a roguelike card draft. Slice leaping salmon out of the air, take one card every morning, and sell the catch to a raccoon who is openly robbing you. Miss the bill and the notice goes final. Fish don't pay bills. Slicing them does.

apps.name: Sanctuary
apps.short_description: Find salvation within the overgrown depths of the forgotten in Sanctuary, an atmospheric 2.5D adventure. Uncover lost secrets, overcome the dark and seek out a moment of respite amongst the thorns as you fight to carve out a place of peace in a world caught between ruin and rebirth.

apps.name: Sanguine Masquerade
apps.short_description: A detective game about finding human traits in a mansion of vampires! Monster hunters beware: Lord Sanguine knows how to find you.

apps.name: SawedoffMysteries
apps.short_description: A narrative hidden-object mystery adventure set in Hawaii. Search detailed scenes for hidden objects, inspect evidence, and assemble your case. Choose your detective, follow the investigation, and uncover the culprit behind a tropical mystery.

apps.name: Scraps
apps.short_description: A multiplayer action-survival game on an isolated island, in a world ruled by machines. Gather resources, craft gear, build your base and explore guarded monuments, facing hostile creatures and machines in a persistent world shared with other survivors.

apps.name: Secret Photos - The New Girl Got Me Hooked!
apps.short_description: In this office simulation, step into the shoes of a hopeless pervert pining for a new coworker, Lily. Work hard to earn money, buy upgrades, collect sneaky videos of Lily, and build your relationship with her. Play your cards right and you might get her hooked on your quirky hobbies!

apps.name: Senders - Wide Open Dirtbike Sim
apps.short_description: Senders is a Dirtbike Simulator taking place over a 20km squared plot of roads, tracks, trails and wilderness. Built from the ground up to provide the deepest, dirtiest riding experience available.

apps.name: Serial Founder
apps.short_description:
You have an idea and no company. A few signatures later you have a company and no control.

A startup life sim where investors are people, the term sheet is a document you can

actually misread, and failure is the punchline. Every run a new company, 30 minutes to 4 hours.

apps.name: Shades of Europa
apps.short_description: Raid bosses for one to four players. Pick a class, learn each boss's mechanics, dodge the telegraphs and bring it down together, with bots in any empty slot. Under the ice of Jupiter's moon Europa sleep the Shades, and every one of them is a fight built for four.

apps.name: Shortcut Hero: Grid City
apps.short_description: Turn real keyboard shortcuts into devastating attacks in a fast-paced arcade action game. Defend Grid City from relentless robot invasions, chain explosive combos, and master the skills that separate heroes from high-score legends.

apps.name: Shot
apps.short_description: Stand your ground in a Western shooting gallery roguelite. Hit weak spots, shoot down incoming attacks, and combine perks into powerful builds. Face varied enemies and bosses in combat where precision, quick reactions, and every reload matter.

apps.name: Shrunken Spa
apps.short_description: At just 2 inches tall, live out a giantess foot fetish fantasy at Shrunken Spa. Massage, lick and worship towering clients, build relationships, raise your reputation, unlock special events, and try not to fail the same client 3 times - because you might not walk out of there alive...

apps.name: Sir, We Have a Pit Problem!
apps.short_description: Sir, We Have a Pit Problem is a bullet-heaven action roguelite. You play as a hole in the ground that swallows innocent soldiers' bodies and souls. Unlock meta upgrades, build absurd weapon combinations, and survive growing hordes. Unlock necromancy to summon devoured foes as your own demon army.

apps.name: Siren's Call: Second Wind
apps.short_description: A wedding where one of the guests arrives dead. A strange black hole eclipsing the Florida sun. And your best friend? Gone. Is all this a butterfly dream or is reality breaking? Is their story romance or mystery? Your choices will determine the genre of his soul. Welcome to the town of Siren's Call.

apps.name: Siribird
apps.short_description: Shiritori (Japanese word-chain) x typing battle on a 5x5 emoji board! Type a reading in romaji to take tiles. Play solo vs 0-3 CPUs (voice input supported), online with up to 4 players via Steam, or up to 4 on one PC. Missed? Win the "Gone!" vote.

apps.name: Slay the GoblinZ
apps.short_description: The Princess has been kidnapped! Play as a knight hired to rescue Her Highness in this short fantasy incremental game. Craft unique equipment, experiment with deadly builds, and unlock dozens of powerful upgrades.

apps.name: SliceShot Padel
apps.short_description:
SliceShot Padel — Experience padel like never before.
Realistic physics, authentic movement, and tactical gameplay built for true padel fans.

apps.name: Slop Machine
apps.short_description: An arcade cabinet slot machine. Play classic arcade games, gamble, win, buy upgrades, go broke.

apps.name: Snapped In The Act!
apps.short_description:
Steal the art. Catch your friends in the act. Hide among museum visitors, pocket exhibits and photograph rival thieves. Get
snapped mid-theft and you're out! A stealth party game for 2–10 players, with Solo, Duo and Thief / Photographer modes.

apps.name: Someone is in my House
apps.short_description: Someone is in my house is a psychological horror game about a streamer having an unexpected event during one of the streams which leaves the streamer being paranoid wondering if they are safe in their own house.

apps.name: SONIC PICO PARK
apps.short_description:
The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog!
This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

apps.name: Sort Them Cats
apps.short_description: Thousands of cats, each with a place! Collect, match, and sort over 5,000 cat figurines in this relaxing organizing game. Unlock helpful abilities, discover hidden surprises, and turn a messy shop into a colorful collection at your own pace.

apps.name: Sort Them Eggs
apps.short_description: A cozy sorting sim: put almost 10,000 eggs on their shelves in a castle, a night amusement park and a huge shopping mall. Earn money for every egg, upgrade your skills and collect 300+ funny eggs at your own pace.

apps.name: Space Combat Simulator
apps.short_description: Space Combat Simulator is a spacecraft action simulator. Choose one of dozens of ships to complete many dangerous missions across the solar system. Take part in epic battles, conquer bases and destroy large battleships.

apps.name: Space Travelers
apps.short_description: Mine asteroids, trade minerals and chart an endless, procedurally generated galaxy in a relaxed 2D space sim. Then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper: your ship keeps flying, mining and discovering while you work

apps.name: Spacel
apps.short_description: A fast, hand-drawn roguelite space shooter for 1–4 players. Rebuild your ship in the between-wave workshop, survive a living cosmos of dying stars, black holes and gravity, and break the three-phase REVENANT. Play solo, local versus, or online co-op.

apps.name: Spasiba!
apps.short_description: Build a scrappy deck, chain actions, and outscore your rivals in Spasiba!, a courtyard deck-building card game. Choose your kingdom, find card combinations, and turn a modest starting hand into a winning engine.

apps.name: spin boom boom
apps.short_description: Toggle pivot points via key presses, dodge collisions, and take on the ultimate test of timing and precision.

apps.name: Splatt
apps.short_description: A competitive online obstacle racer for two to four players. Sprint, jump and climb through physics-driven courses while carrying a fragile egg that shatters on impact. Trigger trap crates, shove rivals off ledges, and finish with your egg intact for full points, or empty-handed for half.

apps.name: SquareFrontlineTD
apps.short_description: Embark on a strategic journey in SquareFrontlineTD, a refreshing 3D low-poly tower defense game! Build unique towers on a floating  block island, master three distinct game modes, and use gold to upgrade your defenses against endless waves of incoming blocky monsters.

apps.name: Starliners
apps.short_description: From Earth to the Moon and beyond, build colonies, develop industries, and manage supply chains in this incremental logistics game. Harness the resources of the Solar System to build an ark and carry humanity to other stars.

apps.name: Starwaste
apps.short_description: Starwaste is a voxel space sandbox about exploration, survival and building. Dismantle wreckage, research resources and turn an abandoned scrapyard into a base — alone or with a crew.

apps.name: STASIS PROTOCOL
apps.short_description: Cyberpunk pixel-art auto-shooter. Your weapons fire on their own: you dodge bullet curtains, freeze the battlefield with Stasis, and pick 1 of 3 new weapons every floor. Climb 50 floors across 5 worlds and take down 10 bosses.

apps.name: Stellations
apps.short_description: A game about going in circles.

apps.name: Succubus Temptation
apps.short_description:
Succubus Temptation is a classic action game for masochistic audiences. Utilize basic controls such as attack, guard, and dodge to face off against succubi.
Guard at the perfect timing to stagger enemies with a "just guard." Perfecting this move will be the key to conquering foes.

apps.name: Sumo Pixel
apps.short_description: Grab three friends and shove them off the stage! Sumo Pixel is a physics party brawler for up to four players, on the couch or online. Sling off ropes, smash through the floor and send your friends flying as the stage crumbles around you. Last square standing wins.

apps.name: Sunken Choir
apps.short_description: Your trial dive ends on the reef. Rebuild the wreck room by room, from emergency boat to the MERIDIAN, and dive into one seamless ocean of reefs, wrecks and vents. Something down there is singing. A co-op deep-sea adventure in pixel art for 1 to 8 players.

apps.name: Sus Chef
apps.short_description: A chaotic first-person online multiplayer cooking and social deduction game for up to 12 players. Take orders, cook, serve and keep the restaurant clean to improve the rating while hidden saboteurs try to cause chaos and bring the restaurant to ruin!

apps.name: SYSTEM 21
apps.short_description: Manipulate a blackjack game from the inside as a dealer subroutine in this minimalist roguelike deckbuilder. Read the visible card's queue, execute illegal code exploits to alter the upcoming cards, and fleece high-rolling patrons before the system anti-cheat detects your anomaly.

apps.name: SystemsCritical
apps.short_description: A cargo freighter has gone SYSTEMS CRITICAL with something alive aboard. As its expendable emergency robots, save the ship while you can, then escape with the cargo when you can't. One friend can play the alien instead: blind, it feels your every footstep.

apps.name: Tama In-Between
apps.short_description: A puzzle platformer where a slime cat absorbs, splits, and possesses to overcome the unique challenges of each stage.

apps.name: Tama Pet
apps.short_description: Raise your own desktop companion! Feed, decorate, collect cute accessories, open surprise packs, and watch your virtual pet grow while it keeps you company throughout the day.

apps.name: Tavern: Tidy Up
apps.short_description:
Warm, handcrafted-looking environments with a medieval atmosphere
Barrels, bread, goblets, meat, pots, and many other diverse items
Relaxing room-to-room gameplay
An inn that expands and unlocks new areas as you clean
Character upgrades
Pressure-free and stress-free gaming experience

apps.name: Terraform Co: Factory and City
apps.short_description: One pod, one core, and an unsurveyed plot on a green world. Clear the ground, trap native grazers, mine metal and rock, and belt it all into a factory — then build the city that buys what you make. Fill contracts, climb the S&G-15 index, and keep the raiders off your core.

apps.name: Terrible Lizards
apps.short_description: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

apps.name: Thank You 4 Playing
apps.short_description: Gather information on social media in-game to take down every last boss in this deduction-based puzzle adventure game inspired by Return of the Obra Dinn. It's release day for the latest entry in a legendary action game series, and you need to beat it. Fun is secondary, victory is all.

apps.name: The Debtician
apps.short_description: Buy items to gain debt in this level-based Credit Card deckbuilder game!

apps.name: The Final Days of Olin Earl
