apps.short_description: Investigate, trespass, eavesdrop, and platform through a would-be murder mystery as a lovable old grandpa who made a deal with Death for all the right reasons.

apps.name: The Good Ghouls
apps.short_description: The Good Ghouls is a brawler-meets-adventure game combining gameplay with campy horror fun. Switch between two step-brother with their own special talents, meet offbeat characters alongside a killer soundtrack, and fight a demonic robot uprising to take back the town of Ghoulcrest.

apps.name: The Helix Frontier
apps.short_description: A co-op sci-fi looter shooter built around movement, randomized weapons and replayable PvE missions. Fight through hostile worlds, build around powerful weapon traits, customize your weapons, and take on escalating challenges with your fireteam.

apps.name: The Last Legion
apps.short_description: The Last Legion is an RTS-RPG hybrid shooter that combines Real-Time Strategy, Role-Playing, and Base Building elements. The core gameplay centers on Desperate Survival and Base Reconstruction: you must unlock and build barracks, R&D facilities, and defenses.

apps.name: The Last Mile: Delivery Simulator
apps.short_description:
The Last Mile: Delivery Simulator is a door-to-door delivery simulation where wrong addresses, fragile packages, and unpredictable people turn every drop-off into a challenge.
Every delivery is simple — until something goes wrong.

apps.name: The Lunacy: That game about Cult
apps.short_description: That Game About a Cult is a dark comedy, stealth-management game set in Inquisition-era Spain.  Build and lead a secret cult temple, train Acolytes, perform heretical rituals, and above all else - avoid being burned at the stake.

apps.name: The Maker Way
apps.short_description: Design machines from parts, 3D-print them, and control your fleet. Build outposts to store data, charge, and refuel. Fight government robots and break into bases to retrieve lost knowledge. First-person sandbox engineering.

apps.name: The Oversight Bureau
apps.short_description:
The Oversight Bureau is a voice-driven narrative adventure game. 
You are candidate 404, trapped inside C.U.T.E. - a rehabilitation program designed to make you a more “appropriate” member of society. As time ticks away and days blur, escape is the only way to keep your sanity and your voice, 404.

apps.name: The Pearl Shop
apps.short_description: Run a debt-ridden pearl jewellery shop in a seaside town. Open shells, design jewellery, serve customers and sell on consignment. Every part of the shop is yours to manage. Meet locals from all walks of life; how you treat them shapes whether you become friends, lovers or enemies.

apps.name: The Pyramid
apps.short_description: The Pyramid is an indie and roguelike roulette challenge that celebrates all of those games that have been collecting dust in your Steam library.

apps.name: The Red Weight
apps.short_description: A story-rich mystery on Mars where your choices matter. You play as a geologist in a Martian habitat investigating a secret that has been ten thousand years patient.

apps.name: The Regreening
apps.short_description: Restore a deserted world in a cozy soilpunk simulation. Grow plants, rebuild wildlife habitats, and revive entire ecosystems. Upcycle abandoned junk into tools and decorations, befriend ancient nature spirits, and hug ALL the animals as you transform a forgotten world into a thriving paradise.

apps.name: The Veil Express
apps.short_description: A cosy management game on a hidden magical train, where you build rooms and workshops for goblins, witches, fairies, ghosts and vampires. Keep the Five Houses happy and spend the Veil wisely: the same magic that powers your train and keeps it hidden.

apps.name: The Wake Event
apps.short_description: Awaken aboard a silent orbital research station. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover the crew's fate, and survive the growing influence of ARGUS, the station's ever-watchful AI.

apps.name: The World's Shortest Horror Game
apps.short_description: Press one button. Regret it immediately. A bite-sized analog horror comedy made to be finished in minutes, streamed for reactions, or gifted to a friend as a tiny act of betrayal. Headphones strongly recommended. Friendship not guaranteed.

apps.name: The Zyrdain Sands
apps.short_description: Welcome to CO-OPPOSED gameplay. Shoot, evolve, and survive in this visceral Twin Stick Shooter while Demon Gods constantly sabotage your run with no-shots, sandstorms, and cursed upgrades as you evolve Zyrd's weapons to save the Sacred Stone.

apps.name: Three Kingdoms: March
apps.short_description: Three Kingdoms: March is a tactical strategy simulation where you command troops with drag-based orders and build your realm through officers, policies, and research. Outmaneuver enemies in real-time battles, strike their flanks and rear, and prepare your path to unification.

apps.name: Thugs in Fantasy
apps.short_description:
You know nothing about magic.
You don't know how to swing a sword.
Fortunately, you know how to throw a punch.

apps.name: Tides Of Tethys
apps.short_description:
A tactical exploration building game where you explore the uncharted depths of Tethys; scavenging resources and lost technologies, to survive the dangers of the abyss.
As the Overseer, lead expeditions of Knights through the dark trenches and the unknown, and help them rebuild their lost Kingdom.

apps.name: Tidy Tails
apps.short_description: Your cat has turned the shop upside down, and 5,555 cat plushies are waiting to go back on their shelves. Upgrade your skills and your cat's, change the weather to transform the gameplay, play minigames and hunt for collectibles while you wonder what the garage hides once everything is tidy.

apps.name: Tiles of Grimmwoods
apps.short_description: Every tile you place in this strategic roguelike deck-builder shapes the story of lost kids trying to escape the twisted depths of the Grimmwoods. Outsmart lurking creatures, lay down paths with powerful items, and upgrade your deck to survive a forest that shifts with every step.

apps.name: till death ROLLS us apart
apps.short_description: Face grotesque monsters in a dark, hand-drawn dice-building roguelike. Collect strange dice, stack modifiers, and build combinations that keep you alive through an endless series of turn-based duels.

apps.name: Tiny Public Enemy
apps.short_description: Be a tiny robot. Cause a very big problem. Dodge angry human crowds, collect phones, evolve your weapons and recruit rebellious appliance buddies in a colourful bullet heaven. Build ridiculous combinations, earn permanent upgrades and turn everyday gadgets into glorious chaos.

apps.name: TOGISHI - Katana Polishing Simulator
apps.short_description: Polish the rust from a blade and wake the hamon sleeping beneath it. Switch stones, clear the rust, bring up the luster. But every stroke thins the steel. Where you stop is yours to decide. A stage-based polishing simulator across 32 blades.

apps.name: Tokyo Desire
apps.short_description: Explore a 3D Tokyo neighborhood, chat with its residents, and get closer to three heroines. Dive into their inner worlds in a story-rich deckbuilding roguelike. Build card combos, read enemy intents, and turn defense into a counterattack.

apps.name: Torii: Beyond The Gates
apps.short_description: The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Forge the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why the links inside the spirit realm have been broken. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.

apps.name: Town of Tinysville
apps.short_description: Town of Tinysville is a deck building roguelike set on tiny maps with huge stakes. Strategically place buildings, grow your deck, and master powerful synergies. Enhance your run using unique chance cards, landmarks, and powerful laws that permanently affect your town.

apps.name: Trace Pocket: Billiards
apps.short_description: A 2D billiards game with simple rules yet full of challenges. Play locally with a friend or take on AI opponents of varying difficulty levels. Earn rewards to sharpen your aiming skills, defeat the toughest AI, and become a billiards legend!

apps.name: Triviatro
apps.short_description: Triviatro is a fast-paced trivia roguelite with no multiple choice. Solve three clues at once as letters fall, build each answer letter by letter, grow valuable letters, stack powerful perks, and turn knowledge, quick thinking, and smart builds into massive scores across 13,000+ questions.

apps.name: Tryll Colony
apps.short_description: A medieval colony sim where every villager talks back. Guide a small village through harsh seasons and speak to your settlers in your own words, by text or by voice. They remember, haggle, gossip and hold you to your promises. All AI runs locally on your PC.

apps.name: Turkish Casino Simulator
apps.short_description: Demon Pokure Kakka II is a Japanese Heavy Metal Demon from Hell. Hellbent on bringing Hell to Earth, he needs one last broken country: Cyprus. He bought Kristos’s €40,000 debt. You have one week at the casino to save your friend and Cyprus from Seikimatsu (End of the Century / Apocalypse).

apps.name: UberLoop
apps.short_description: Smash your way through endless waves of enemies and grow absurdly powerful! Explore the map, grab loot from shrines, level up with unique upgrades, unlock new characters, and stack wild abilities to create crazy builds as you fend off hordes of creatures!

apps.name: UMBRATIO - THE ODDS ARE FIXED
apps.short_description: Read the odds of an illegal fight circuit and bet on the matches everyone else has misjudged. Buy unreliable tips, study injuries, traits, and fight patterns, and interfere before the bell when needed. Repay your debt, buy shares, reach bigger fights, and decide whether the loser lives or dies.

apps.name: Understory
apps.short_description:
Play as a fox mother that takes care of her cubs.
You can play with your cubs, hunt for them and play small minigames.
Make friends in the forest, but watch out for dangers.
Not suitable for children or people that are easily disturbed

apps.name: Unforeseen Consequences - Zone 19
apps.short_description: A 144 km² Zone where space folds back on itself and time refuses to keep its pace. Survive radiation, anomalies and armed patrols in a VR survival shooter built on real ballistics. Find a way out, or stay and hunt the artifacts the Zone keeps hidden.

apps.name: Utopium
apps.short_description: UTOPIUM is a dystopian top-down brawler about avenging the death of a pigeon. Carve a path through the Factory with the spirit hammer: smack the soul out of your enemies, bounce it off the walls, terrify anyone it passes through, then reverse-possess it to appear behind your next target.

apps.name: Void Walker
apps.short_description: Void Walker is an endless 2D pixel-art platformer set in a dark abyss. Use simple controls and precise timing to dodge deadly obstacles, collect glowing orbs, and beat your highest score.

apps.name: Warehouse: Catastrophe
apps.short_description: Warehouse: Catastrophe is a cozy warehouse organizing simulator where you clean, sort, and repack over 4,170 products into 1,415 delivery boxes. Restore a disaster-filled warehouse alongside your orange cat companion, unlock new abilities, and bring order back at your own relaxing pace.

apps.name: Warithmetic
apps.short_description: Warithmetic is a real-time strategy factory-builder where equations create armies. Add, multiply, divide, combine, and route numbers into melee, ranged, and healer units, then outproduce an adaptive AI or compete in online team battles for up to six players.

apps.name: Waterline
apps.short_description: A first-person horror game in the style of the original PlayStation. The city is going under, and you have to last seven nights in your flat. By day, find food and board up the door. At night, look through the peephole and decide who comes in.

apps.name: Waveling Island
apps.short_description: Waveling Island is a Creature-Collecting RPG with Autobattling, that takes place on a beautiful, hand-drawn pixelart island full of creatures called Wavelings. Catch, train and battle these creatures in order to complete quests, gather materials, and make a stake in this new tropical home of yours.

apps.name: Way of the Warrior
apps.short_description: Become a samurai in Way of the Warrior, a souls-like PvP and boss rush game. Face other players in intense duels or fight a gauntlet of powerful warriors in a world inspired by feudal Japan. Parry, dodge, feint and attack until only one of you is left standing.

apps.name: Wet Witch
apps.short_description: An erotic point and click adventure game with beautiful 2D graphics. Fully interactive sex mini games, quests, narrative story telling, and optional item crafting to increase your pleasure. Explore and discover the open world sandbox at your own pace.

apps.name: While Shifu's Away: Senior Sister, I've Fallen for You!
apps.short_description: Shifu is away, and your shy junior brother can no longer hide his feelings. Play as the senior sister in a sweet xianxia romance visual novel where replies and daily choices shape your bond and lead to different endings. And yes, the main characters sing original songs!

apps.name: Whispering Eclipsia
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror detective thriller. Play as Inspector Keshav, investigate a mysterious murder, interrogate suspects, uncover disturbing evidence, and confront the terrifying secrets hidden within Woods Lane. But beware—some truths are better left buried.

apps.name: Worms: Galactic Tactics
apps.short_description: Worms makes an explosive leap into tactical roguelike combat! Battle across destructible arenas, mod classic weapons and unleash devastating strategic combos as you fight for survival, riches and glory!

apps.name: Yokai Night Bazaar
apps.short_description: Turn a forgotten mountain street into a cozy yokai night bazaar. Gather ingredients, choose stalls, and let an odd little crew get to work. Keep recipes between runs, learn lasting upgrades, and prepare seven lantern-lit festivals.

apps.name: Zap Blastum
apps.short_description: Zap always dreamed of saving the galaxy, and now it's time! Snap into cover, lock onto targets, and outsmart an army of robots in this fast-paced top-down cover shooter.

apps.name: にゃんこサバイバー
apps.short_description: Cat Survivor is a minefield auto-battler where mines become your greatest weapon. Read the numbers, place your flags, trigger explosive chain reactions, and wipe out entire hordes. Win with strategy, not brute force.

apps.name: ぺちぺちハクスラ
apps.short_description:
A hack-and-slash RPG where you defeat monsters, gather materials, and grow stronger through equipment crafting and skills.
The more you upgrade, the faster your material farming becomes!
Watching your stats steadily rise is irresistibly addictive!

apps.name: やさ死くシて
apps.short_description:
Welcome, Subject 03. It's time for your psychological experiments.

Four experiments. 56 endings. Save others, abandon them, or put yourself first. Every choice is yours.

A simple game, really. Just decide how to use your kindness.

Heh. Can you be kind? To yourself—and to others.

apps.name: インクリ米ンタル
apps.short_description: Grow rice in your paddies, make onigiri in your kitchen car, and sell them to a line of hungry customers! Clear rocky wasteland, automate with rice planters and combines, and expand from the farm to a graveyard, the sea, the city, hell, and outer space in this incremental onigiri shop game.

apps.name: パチっとヒパチー かけだせ！パチパチときめき花火大会！
apps.short_description: In order to create a fireworks festival, let's collect fireworks seeds with a rush action! It is a 3D action that feels good to collect seeds by rushing forward with a simple button operation! Rush to blocks, enemies, and many species! Let's find rare seeds and make the fireworks festival a success!

apps.name: ムゲン階段　団地編
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in an apartment stairwell looping from the 2nd to the 10th floor. Notice changes in doors, windows, and sounds, uncover the code, and find a way to the rooftop.

apps.name: ローマ帝国の逆襲　Counter Attack of Roman Empire
apps.short_description:
【概要】：「ローマ帝国の逆襲」は、若き将軍・ユリアヌスとなり、ローマ軍を率い帝国領州ガリア地区に侵入した蛮族を撃破して、再び平和を回復することが目的です。
【デザイン】：RTSゲームで、偵察、配置、戦闘、補充を行います。戦闘の評価により報酬（金、食料、捕虜（兵士として雇用することが可能））が変化します。戦闘の評価は、制限時間内（食料が尽きるまで）に敵の部隊の撃滅率、ユリアヌス及び味方の生存率です。
得られる報酬によって次の戦闘の難易度が変化するでしょう。但し、強大な敵の場合は撤退も検討することが必要になります。
時間制限もあるので迅速な状況把握と決断が重視されるゲームです。

apps.name: 下一站青城
apps.short_description: Enter the mythic world of Sanctum: Whispers of Qingcheng, Seek ascension through the Three Orthodox Schools, or delve into the Nine Unorthodox Arts of the mortal realm—mastering forbidden arts like corpse refinement and demonic shapeshifting. Your path defines the realm.

apps.name: 今夜为您特调
apps.short_description: Explore Serenpt with 9 love interests in this multi-ending JRPG. You are one of the successors chosen by the influential Godmother, recently entrusted with running a bar and handling Cheleamon’s Family affairs. However, she has set a condition—within six weeks, you must prove that you are worthy.

apps.name: 凡修
apps.short_description: Fan Xiu is an idle cultivation game. Break through realms while elixirs, artifacts, and rare treasures drop over time. Every item you earn can be freely listed and traded on the Steam Market — idle your way to immortality, and to real profit. Limited-time events regularly drop exclusive items

apps.name: 姐姐恋爱法则
apps.short_description: Welcome to the Yuri story full of women!  Play as an urban lady, would you choose your haunting-crush, assertive ex-girlfriend, cute best friend, mystery online friend, or...?

apps.name: 宅建らぶ -異世界アルカナシア・土地法復興記-
apps.short_description: 宅建士試験に、物語で挑む学習ビジュアルノベル。土地の取引が信じられなくなった異世界アルカナシアで、二十八歳の宅建士・神崎直人は五人のヒロインと相談窓口を開く。住み替え事業の契約、手付、登記、融資の食い違いを一つずつ確かめるうちに、宅建業法・権利関係・法令上の制限・税の論点が、理由と一緒につながっていく。過去問450問、本試験と同じ形式の模擬試験、暗記カード、黒板講義、文章を生成しない検索型の宅建AIつき。完全オフライン。

apps.name: 怪異対策特異機関ー幻視天研所ー
apps.short_description:
【With every corpse, you move forward.】
You won't know unless you try. You die because you don't know. Once you die, you know.
Try ATTACK, TALK, WAIT, and RETREAT on Anomalies. Read their reactions, discover the right way to deal with them, and uncover how to suppress them.

apps.name: 成本 1000 元的 Galgame
apps.short_description: 高考后，身为学渣的你决定冒充在校大学生去找家教兼职，没想到，你的第一个顾客竟然是和你同班的学霸同学，你们的故事就此开始……

apps.name: 我的幸福人生-My Happy Life
apps.short_description: Kevin dies in a car crash and wakes up in a strange new world filled with gentle wives, cool mature women, and cute girls. He also meets many beauties—teachers, doctors, police officers, nurses, and streamers. Can he find happiness in this new life?

apps.name: 抓住魅魔
apps.short_description: "Catch the Succubus" is a first-person comedy horror game. The mischievous succubus has designed various gameplay for players, including memory puzzles, platform jumping, and navigating through the dark. You just need to catch her to win.

apps.name: 流火 A Glimmer
apps.short_description: “A Glimmer”is a FMV . Set in 1940’s  China, the protagonist  takes the identity of  agent Wang Qiming. Navigates bandits, National Revolutionary Army, Japanese‑puppet forces and Communist underground groups. Choices between justice, personal revenge and self‑identity bring totally distinct endings.

apps.name: 深夜閲覧 Midnight Reading：Showa Echoes
apps.short_description: Midnight Reading is a short horror adventure set in a Showa-era Japanese school. As a library committee member, search for overdue books. Read, return, and make choices as the story branches into three routes and a True Route.

apps.name: 牌武者
apps.short_description:
Card Warrior is a wuxia roguelike card game combining martial arts and card mechanics. Play cards to strike, parry, counterattack, and strike relentlessly when you spot enemies’ flaws.
Walk the path of a worrior. What kind of hero will you be?

apps.name: 玉石大师
apps.short_description: Every rough stone holds opportunity and risk. Choose stones, grind windows into the crust, and decide whether to keep revealing or accept a customer's offer. Keep jade to craft collectibles, run your own jade shop, complete commissions, and build a collection.

apps.name: 界墨山河
apps.short_description: 《INK Mountains And Rivers》is a casual ink style idle collection and cultivation game, with themes taken from worldviews similar to Shanhai and Honghuang. It is a mountain and river world full of exotic beasts. Here, you can collect various exotic beasts, cultivate them to become stronger.

apps.name: 終末生徒 The Last Student：Showa Era Radio Room
apps.short_description:
A Showa-era school, a radio room at night. In a building where you are not alone, you repeat broadcasts.

Strange responses return. Records change, unknown logs grow.

Reality begins to erode, and the story twists through your choices. Ten endings await.

apps.name: 翻转夜市
apps.short_description: A night-market strategy game built on Reversi. Learn the classic rules as you play, pick up different tricks to make a fortune at the market, and unlock the little stories of the stallholders and trouble customers, feeling the warmth and chill of life among the night-market people.

apps.name: 蚕代-Koshiro-
apps.short_description: Misaki, your girlfriend, has vanished. Following the faintest of leads, you arrive at one man's apartment. In the beam of your flashlight, white threads and a household Shinto shrine emerge from the dark... A first-person, modern Japanese exploration-and-escape horror game themed around silkworms.

apps.name: 象棋三国志
apps.short_description:
The Han dynasty is fading, and warlords rise. The realm has shattered like a broken chessboard, with no end in sight.

The land is your board, its soilder your pieces. Enter the chaos of the Three Kingdoms, command armies, outwit rivals, seize cities, and fight for dominion!

apps.name: 起業×経営体験ゲーム『おいでよ！スタートアップ村』フェニックス編
apps.short_description: Welcome to The Startup Village is an entrepreneurship and management simulation board game. Players experience the entire startup cycle: securing funding and hiring staff (Startup Phase), followed by 12 months of realistic business operations (Management Phase) .

apps.name: 足球经理：自走棋
apps.short_description: A football management game mixed with collection career play. You manage a themed club, schedule training, recruitment and league fixtures, then drag coach cards to command near-realtime matches as you climb from lower leagues to bigger stages.

apps.name: 速速修仙
apps.short_description: Swift Cultivation is a text-based idle game. Set your action queue, and let time do the rest: auto-breakthrough when cultivation is maxed, eat when HP is low. Die, and you'll reincarnate stronger. Idle from Qi Refining Layer 1 to Spirit Transformation Layer 10, and ascend!

apps.name: 野球拳
apps.short_description:
Yakyuken: Unclothed & Unhinged

Zero stripping! A pure comedy school ADV.

Reika, a rebellious rich girl, gets transferred to a rural school and instantly ends up in a life-or-death Yakyuken battle with the cafeteria owner over a broken ticket machine. But a dark conspiracy lurks behind it all.
